course.title: React.js — Complete Practical Frontend Development Course
course.description: A deep practical React course covering JSX, components, props, state, events, hooks, API integration, forms, routing, architecture, advanced state, accessibility, testing, performance and a complete student learning platform.
learningOutcomes: Build student dashboard and lesson pages.
Implement progress and task submission UI.
Apply accessibility, testing and performance practices.
Build a production-style student learning platform.
